title: Recruited into Army intelligence by a civilian in the Fort Jackson beer hall

tellings.quote: and so when I went in the trailer I found out that he was a guy who was in intelligence

plain: Joe McMoneagle says that in the 1960s, as a young soldier at Fort Jackson, South Carolina, a civilian he met in the base beer hall recruited him into Army intelligence. He says that when he went into the man's trailer, "I found out that he was a guy who was in intelligence." McMoneagle tells Michels this from his own life, as the start of his time in intelligence work.
